services.name: Picnic Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a picnic on the water! Three hours About Relax on the water from 11 in the morning until 2 in the afternoon. Choose an itinerary, or have Captain Chip suggest one. The final course will be set by the Captain according to weather, tides, and sailing conditions. Included We provide ice, water and basic serving items (paper plates, napkins, utensils) – you supply any food or beverages (including alcoholic beverages) you choose. Not Included Tips What to bring Dress however you like, although casual attire is best for an outing on the water. We also recommend boat shoes, sneakers, For all ages! • Three Hours • Up to four passengers with the option to add more! • May - October

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a sunset on the water! Three hours About Put a perfect ending on the day with a three-hour sail at sunset. Cruising times for Sunset Cruises on Seabird vary through the season to match the three hours before sunset; 6:00 to 9:00 p.m. May to July, 5:00 to 8:00 p.m. in August, and 3:00 to 6:00 p.m. in September and October. Choose an itinerary, or have Captain Chip suggest one. The final course will be set by the Captain according to weather, tides, and sailing conditions. Bring your favorite food and beverages, or arrange catering from local providers. Included We provide ice, For all ages! • Three Hours • May - October • Up to four passengers with the option to add more!

services.name: Quick Cruise
services.desc: Come experience Fenwick, Old Saybrook; or Essex, Connecticut by boat! One hour About We’re happy to help you organize a Unique Outing Plan. Seabird can take you to a destination, cruise around the area, anchor so you can go for a swim, or dock and have you go ashore for lunch or shopping. Another Custom Cruise option is to sail to a location where we drop you off to spend the day ashore. You can return later by ferry, Uber or Lyft, or have Seabird take you back. We can also schedule to pick you up a day or more after drop-off. Included We provide ice, water and basic serving items For all ages! • One Hour • Up to four passengers with the option to add more! • May - October

blurb: Seabird Cruises offers 3-hour scenic cruises for up to six guests on a classic New England Dyer 29 picnic boat skippered by a USCG licensed captain. Cruises include Picnic Cruises, Sunset Cruises, and Custom Cruises up to 10 hours. Guests can bring their own food or arrange catering and enjoy views of Long Island Sound and the Connecticut River.

quotes.text: We were looking for a unique experience to celebrate a milestone birthday event with three generations of family during the Covid-19 pandemic period. The brunch boat outing turned out to be the perfect way to celebrate my husband’s 75th birthday with our son, daughter-in-law, and grandchildren. A wonderful day was enjoyed by all! Many thanks!

Sending you a note of deep appreciation for the extra communication from your entire team as our future son-in-law planned a special outing to propose to our daughter on your boat. Our Captain Chip in particular kept in great contact with us at every step to ensure this very special event was a success!

We had a spectacular dinner on the water with Captain Chip who brought us to the perfect location to enjoy the most beautiful sunset, truly stunning. We all commented that we travel far and wide and did not know how beautiful the Connecticut shoreline sunset can be!
